verdict.rationale: Figma provides REST/Plugin APIs to extract objects, layers, and metadata (figma-docs-7, figma-docs-49), but this is developer-level partial extraction, not a full open-format data export enabling clean migration. Community evidence explicitly contradicts the openness claim, noting that 'your full fidelity work is locked up in a proprietary format' with no way to keep a fully synced local copy (figma-comm-7). Missing for 10: a documented full-account/data export feature in an open standard format, evidence of successful migration away from Figma, and confirmation that exported data preserves full fidelity.
